resolution: Built fluffy grass as a surface population system (FluffyGrass technique). Phase 1: GrassBlade crossed-quad geometry + grassPopulation.ts deterministic per-cell roll over painted grass/grassDry tiles (reuses scatter.ts hash) + GrassField (one Scene3D.Instances) wired into WorldStatics. Phase 2: grass_wgsl scene3d pipeline in 3d.zig (vertex wind tip-weighted world-noise gust, fragment procedural wisp cutout + root-to-tip gradient), routed via ~grass~ tex-key sentinel; time written to the former _pad3 uniform slot. Built clean (SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0), self-shot PASS, shows in editor iso/play 3D. Phase 3 (no-V8 /compiled bake) PENDING: the streaming.zig/constructor.zig shapeId->geometry seam needs mapping to add GrassBlade to the native loader. NOT committed — shared hot files (3d.zig/shaders.zig) co-edited by parallel sessions; needs commit coordination. Full handoff in memory project_grass_system.md.
